sources.title: Paraformer-zh: Efficient Mandarin ASR
sources.snippet: Paraformer-zh is an advanced, non-autoregressive ASR framework for Mandarin that achieves high accuracy and over 10× inference speed using CIF and parallel decoding.

sources.title: paraformer-zh: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview paraformer-zh is a non-autoregressive end-to-end speech recognition model trained by funasr on 60,000 hours of Mandarin data with a 220M parameter architecture.
